name: outside
description: No drone-aircraft conflict: 1.05 km away; 170 m above; next to a drone that is not live; a 31 s old position; a closest approach 80+ s away. Those still below 460 m above ground within 3 km of the live drone are LOW (UAS airspace), with no conflict counted.
worked_example: UAL123 1050 m N of D9A03 (vert +50): beyond 1000 m -> no NEAR; flying away -> no CPA.
N12345 600 m S at 320 m: vert +170 > 150 -> nothing. N9 200 m from DJI-1, which is not live -> nothing. N10 424 m away but 31 s old (not fresh) -> nothing.
SKW9 5.2 km N heading S at 120 kt while D9A03 flies E at 5 m/s: t_cpa = 5200*61.73/(61.73^2+5^2) = 83.7 s > 60 -> nothing.
Status: 'conflict watch on, 3 low aircraft, data 4 s old' - no drone-aircraft conflict is counted, and it never says 'clear', 'safe' or 'no traffic': not every aircraft broadcasts ADS-B.

Also LOW (UAS airspace: airborne, within 3 km of the observer or a live drone, below 460 m above ground; ground = the observer's elevation 20 m): b2c3d4 at t=0 'LOW TRAFFIC S 600 M' ('BE READY TO LAND DRONES; AIRCRAFT 300 M ABOVE GROUND, 600 M S'); a1b2c3 at t=0 'LOW TRAFFIC N 1.1 KM' ('BE READY TO LAND DRONES; AIRCRAFT 180 M ABOVE GROUND, 1.1 KM N'); c3d4e5 at t=0 'LOW TRAFFIC W 2.8 KM' ('BE READY TO LAND DRONES; AIRCRAFT 80 M ABOVE GROUND, 2.8 KM W'). A warning for the same aircraft supersedes its LOW, which shows again once the warning clears.
